thread:
mika: Heads-up — noticed p99 spikes on dedicated pool eu-west-1a right after warmup. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/egress?orgId=1 :eyes:
raj: saw it too. microqueue depth jumps ~right before egress NIC saturates. looks like GPU fanout + small-batch thrash.
kelly: Any tenant correlation? quick grep of logs shows a repeat pattern of ~30-50 small requests from one tenant.
mika: tenant-batcher-17. pattern: burst of tiny payloads -> KV cache churn -> microqueue regen -> egress spike.
oliver: can you paste the query you used? will run it against our panel.
raj: ran these on grafana datasource, output snippet:
```
rate(microqueue.requests[5m]) by (tenant)
sum by (rack) (egress.nic_bytes{region=\"eu-west-1\"})
```
raj: result: tenant-batcher-17 shows 4x baseline, rack-34 egress hit 95% util for ~90s.
eng-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-847 (auto-detected egresstail surge) :rotating_light:
kelly: Short-term mitigations: 1) soft-quarantine tenant, 2) tweak microqueue fairness weights, 3) apply NIC-level shaping (tc) on rack-34. thoughts?
mika: weight tweak first. quarantine reroutes to fallback and will hike GPU cost ~1.2x for their traffic. prefer less-disruptive fix if it restores p99.
raj: allocator supports per-tenant microqueue weight. we can set microqueue.priority[tenant-batcher-17]=0.4. rollback is instant.
oliver: I'll draft the change. also propose adding an alert: microqueue.depth>200 && egress.nic_util>85% for 1m.
kelly: I'll push a tc rule to shape bursts on eth0 of rack-34: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 10` with a low-rate class for tenant bursts. keeping it temporary (30m).
mika: also log cost impact and notify CS. if this repeats we need SDK batching hint to reduce small writes.
oliver: PR #4122 created, includes allocator weight flag, alert rule, and rollout steps.
raj: rolling to canary (rack-34) now. monitoring output: microqueue.depth down ~60% within 45s, p99 gen latency improved by ~120ms.
kelly: tc rule is in place for 30m. watching egress and nvlink stats.
mika: good. keep the temporary quarantine off for now. if we see re-burst we will flip it.
eng-bot: Alert suppressed: microqueue.depth recovered (INC-2024-847 auto-resolve)
oliver: follow-ups: ENG-2310 (SDK batching hints), INFRA-889 (egress shaping runbook), and a short postmortem if recurrence.
kelly: filing the runbook update now. will include playbook commands and quick rollback.
mika: thanks all. agree on long-term: better client-side batching + fair-share microqueue + proactive egress shaping policies. closing thread unless it comes back. :thumbsup:
